claims.reason: The Saudi-Iran restoration agreement substantiates a diplomatic achievement, while the joint statement credits prior Iraq/Oman talks too. It does not create a unified strategic bloc; domestic property and demographic weaknesses continue to coexist with industrial scale.

evidence.title: Saudi-Iran-China joint statement
evidence.finding: Agreement to restore Saudi-Iran diplomatic relations after Beijing talks; statement also credits earlier Iraqi and Omani dialogue.

evidence.title: 2024 economic and demographic statistics
evidence.finding: Population fell 1.39 million; consumer inflation only 0.2% and producer prices fell 2.2%. Aging did not mechanically create inflation.

evidence.title: Geopolitics, trade and the dollar
evidence.finding: Trade and FDI between geopolitical blocs weakened relative to within-bloc flows; renminbi and gold use rose selectively, while USD retained dominance.
